passive.name: Departing Anew
passive.text: After the wearer uses Skill or Ultimate on one ally character, the wearer regenerates **6/6.5/7/7.5/8** Energy and the ability's target receives 1 stack of "Hymn" for **3** turn(s), stacking up to **3** time(s). Each stack of "Hymn" increases its holder's DMG dealt by **15/17.25/19.5/21.75/24%**. After every **2** instance(s) of Skill or Ultimate the wearer uses on one ally character, recovers 1 Skill Point.

passive.name: Heir
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate by **10/12/14/16/18%** and regenerates 1 Skill Point when the wearer uses their Ultimate on an ally. This effect can be triggered once after every 2 uses of the wearer's Ultimate. When the wearer uses their Skill, the next ally taking action (except the wearer) deals **30/35/40/45/50%** more DMG for **1** turn(s).

passive.name: Kites From the Past
passive.text: When the wearer uses their Skill, the next ally taking action (except the wearer) deals **16/20/24/28/32%** increased DMG for **1** turn(s).

passive.name: Cannot Stop It!
passive.text: When the wearer uses their Ultimate, all allies' actions are Advanced Forward by **16/18/20/22/24%**.

substatLine: SPD (Until breakpoint) > CRIT DMG > HP = DEF > Effect RES% (30% If Keel)

entries.name: Windrider Bullet
entries.text: Deals Wind DMG equal to **100%** of Bronya's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Combat Redeployment
entries.text:
Dispels a debuff from a single ally, allows them to immediately take action, and increases their DMG by **66%** for **1** turn(s).
When this Skill is used on Bronya herself, she cannot immediately take action again.

entries.name: The Belobog March
entries.text: Increases the ATK of all allies by **55%**, and increases their CRIT DMG equal to **16%** of Bronya's CRIT DMG plus **20%** for **2** turn(s).

entries.name: Leading the Way
entries.text: After using her Basic ATK, Bronya's next action will be Advanced Forward by **30%**.

entries.name: Banner of Command
entries.text: After using Bronya's Technique, at the start of the next battle, all allies' ATK increases by **15%** for **2** turn(s).

entries.name: Command
entries.text: The CRIT Rate for Basic ATK increases to 100%.

entries.name: Battlefield
entries.text: At the start of the battle, all allies' DEF increases by **20%** for **2** turn(s).

entries.name: Military Might
entries.text: When Bronya is on the field, all allies deal **10%** more DMG.

entries.name: Hone Your Strength
entries.text: When using Skill, there is a 50% fixed chance of recovering 1 Skill Point. This effect has a 1-turn cooldown.

entries.name: Quick March
entries.text: When using Skill, the target ally's SPD increases by 30% after taking action, lasting for 1 turn.

entries.name: Bombardment
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Take by Surprise
entries.text: After any other ally character uses Basic ATK on an enemy target that has Wind Weakness, Bronya immediately launches 1 instance of Follow-Up ATK, dealing Wind DMG to this target equal to 80% of her Basic ATK DMG. This effect can only trigger once per turn.

entries.name: Unstoppable
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Piercing Rainbow
entries.text: The duration of the DMG Boost effect placed by the Skill on the target ally increases by 1 turn(s).
